description: This file defines a WorkflowEditor class extending WorkflowCanvas, managing a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop activities, connections, popovers, and local state persistence. It integrates jsPlumb for connections and jQuery for DOM interactions.

classes.name: WorkflowEditor
classes.description: A class extending WorkflowCanvas that manages a visual workflow editor with drag-and-drop activities, connections, popovers, and local state persistence.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Collects current workflow state including activities and connections.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current workflow state to a JSON string.

methods.name: saveLocalState
methods.description: Saves the current workflow state to session storage.

methods.name: loadLocalState
methods.description: Loads the workflow state from session storage.
